name: Fishing nets drying
description: A tan fishing net hung to dry in loose folds over a long pole, about 2.45 × 0.75 × 2 m, the pole resting on two crossed-pole trestles lashed at the top, the net's foot rope strung with cork floats and a few spare floats on the ground.
